title: FinanceSnapshot
description: A point-in-time P&L reading. Revenue is the only valid scoreboard (Stripe net). Spend proxies are read live by usage.mjs and recorded here per heartbeat. `snapshot_id` is the unique key.

snapshot_id.description: stable key, e.g. a period label

period.description: the window this snapshot covers, e.g. 2026-06 or day-29

stripe_revenue_usd.description: net Stripe revenue in USD (0 while the gate is sealed / test mode)

anthropic_spend_proxy_usd.description: API-equivalent $ proxy from usage.mjs; null if not read

higgsfield_credits.description: remaining Higgsfield generation credits; null if not read

net_usd.description: revenue minus spend proxy; null if incomputable
